concerns.text: Task T004-Report-Validate depends on T004, but T004 depends on T001 (Project Structure) which is listed AFTER T004. The directory hierarchy (code/, data/, tests/) must exist before the data model validation script can run or generate reports. Ordering violation: Consumer (T004) precedes Producer (T001).

Task T006 (Schema Definitions) depends on T004-Report-Validate. However, T004-Report-Validate depends on T004, which depends on T001. T001 (Project Structure) is listed after T004. The schema files in contracts/ cannot be verified or created if the directory structure (contracts/) is not established first. T001 must precede T004 and T006.

Task T013 (Stimulus Generation) depends on T090 (Cue-Intensity Weighting Schemes). T090 creates data/processed/cue_intensity_weights.json. However, T013 also depends on T001 (Project Structure) and T005 (Directory Creation). T005 creates data/raw/ and data/processed/. T001 and T005 are listed AFTER T013 in the Phase 0 block. The output directory for T013 (data/raw/stimuli.csv) must exist before T013 runs.

Task T015b-Real (Real Data Ingestion) depends on T015a (External Recruitment). T015a is an external task, but T015b-Real also implicitly requires the directory structure (data/raw/) created by T005. T005 is listed after T015b-Real. The ingestion script cannot write to data/raw/real_ratings.csv if the directory does not exist.

Task T021a (Primary LMM Fit) depends on T021-AmendPlan. T021-AmendPlan depends on T020 (Analysis-Ready Merge). T020 depends on T016b (Listwise Deletion) and T051 (Anonymisation). T051 depends on T016b. T016b depends on T016a. T016a depends on T015b-Real. T015b-Real depends on T015a. The chain is long, but T021a also depends on T020 which requires T005 (Directory Creation) to exist for data/processed/analysis_ready.csv. T005 is listed after T021a in the list, creating a potential execution order failure if the script runs sequentially without explicit dependency checks.

T090b also depends on T005 (Directory Creation) for data/processed/. T005 is listed after T090b. The directory must exist before the zip file is created.
